name: Rupture
description: Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your Attack Power.  Lasts longer per combo point:   1 point  : 60 damage over 8 secs   2 points: 90 damage over 10 secs   3 points: 126 damage over 12 secs   4 points: 168 damage over 14 secs   5 points: 216 damage over 16 secs
